disclaimer: Evidence confirms npm 12.0.2 package manager CLI and dependency solver contracts; makes NO live publication or external network claims.

groups.manifest_lock: Manifest and lockfile v3 integrity and installation contracts
groups.dependency_topology: Workspaces, peer dependencies, overrides, and optional platform filtering
groups.lifecycle_execution: Lifecycle script suppression, execution, packaging, and config precedence

scenarios.title: Clean Lockfile v3 CI Installation
scenarios.description: Clean npm ci succeeds against matching package-lock.json v3, writes hidden lockfile, and mutates no lockfiles

scenarios.title: Stale Lockfile Refusal Under CI
scenarios.description: npm ci refuses to install when package.json dependencies diverge from package-lock.json, exiting non-zero with sync error

scenarios.title: Install Lockfile Update
scenarios.description: npm install detects added dependency in package.json and updates package-lock.json with new dependency entry

scenarios.title: Monorepo Workspaces Install and Targeted Run
scenarios.description: Workspaces monorepo installs cross-workspace symlinks and executes targeted package script via --workspace

scenarios.title: Compatible Peer Dependency Resolution
scenarios.description: npm install succeeds when peer dependency declaration is satisfied by co-installed host package

scenarios.title: Incompatible Peer Dependency Conflict Refusal
scenarios.description: npm install fails closed with ERESOLVE when peer dependency version requirement conflicts with installed host package

scenarios.title: Overrides Enforcement Resolves Peer Conflict and Verifies Installed Content
scenarios.description: Manifest overrides field resolves conflicting peer dependency; harness verifies installed package version and exported content match the override

scenarios.title: Optional Dependency Platform Filtering
scenarios.description: Optional dependency with mismatched OS constraint is skipped without failing overall installation

scenarios.title: Lifecycle Script Installation Execution, Suppression, and Pre/Post Hooks
scenarios.description: Normal install executes root and dependency lifecycle scripts; --ignore-scripts suppresses install execution; explicit run under --ignore-scripts executes target while suppressing pre/post hooks

scenarios.title: Local Pack Tarball Content and Consumption
scenarios.description: npm pack --json archives allowlisted files and bin links; consumer project successfully installs generated tarball

scenarios.title: Configuration Precedence Across Five Layers via Registry Inspection
scenarios.description: Verifies configuration precedence hierarchy for registry (.invalid): CLI > env > project .npmrc > user .npmrc > global .npmrc

scenarios.title: Local Binary Execution with Download Prevention
scenarios.description: npm exec executes local node_modules/.bin binary; refuses remote package downloads when binary is missing
